title: Ethiopian churches keep the Book of Enoch in their canon
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Ethiopian churches keep the Book of Enoch in their canon, about 4th century AD at Ethiopia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In fact in the fourth around the 4th century uh AD the Tawaho Orthodox Christians and the beta Israel Jew Jewish community in Ethiopia incorporated the book of Enoch into their canon.

plain: A researcher and filmmaker named Tim Alberino says that around the 4th century AD, the Tewahedo Orthodox Christians and the Beta Israel Jewish community in Ethiopia added the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text left out of most Bibles, to their official scriptures. He brings it up because the book tells of fallen angels and giants, which ties into his own claims about giants.
